content:
**Overseer's Camp** is a location in Appalachia.

This camp was set up by the Overseer as she made her way from Vault 76 to the town of Flatwoods. [1] 

“The first clue in the journey of the Overseer is at her recently abandoned C.A.M.P. Learn the basics of crafting here, and remember the three crafting stations can help you during the creation of your own first C.A.M.P”— Atlas of Appalachia

The C.A.M.P. and a Cooking Station are in the middle of the area. On the northeastern side, there is a Sleeping Bag and an Overseer's Cache. To the south is an Armor Workbench. On the southwestern side is a toolbox, a Stash Box and a Weapons Workbench.

- Plan: Metal Bed - On the makeshift table near the tree.

There is a tree with three dead Radstags east-northeast of the camp.

The Overseer's Camp appears in *Fallout 76*.

1. ↑ *Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide* p. 289:*"**OVERSEER'S CAMP****The first clue in the journey of the Overseer is at her recently abandoned C.A.M.P. Learn the basics of crafting here, and remember the three crafting stations can help you during the creation of your own first C.A.M.P."*
(Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide/Atlas of Appalachia)
